decision: Selected the area centroid of Westchester County (Town of Mount Pleasant, SWIS 553489) tax parcel 116.11-1-5 (parcel address 17 SKYLINE DR; property class 449; 2025 assessment roll), as published by the NYS ITS public tax-parcel service, as the reviewed site locator for TierPoint New York - Hawthorne Data Center (HW2), which TierPoint's page names 'Hawthorne Data Center - 17 Skyline Drive'. TierPoint's other Hawthorne building (HWT, 11 Skyline Drive) lies on the separate, non-contiguous parcel 116.7-1-17 and is deliberately excluded.

facts.centroid_method: area centroid of the parcel polygon computed in EPSG:32618 (pyproj 3.7.1, shapely 2.1.1) and transformed to WGS84, rounded to 7 decimals; the EPSG:5070 (CONUS Albers) centroid differs by 0.000 m

reference_points.label: US Census Bureau geocoder (Public_AR_Current) interpolated point for 17 SKYLINE DR, HAWTHORNE, NY, 10532 (street-range interpolation; not used)
